# Longbridge (Platform)

⚠️ **Trading warning / Avertissement trading** : informational only, not investment advice. Market data and account snapshots describe the past and the present, they do not predict prices, and any position can lose value. Curated by Skill Harbor: the base skill of the Longbridge developer platform, published by the broker Longbridge itself. It routes almost any stock or market question to the Longbridge CLI (with an MCP server as fallback): live quotes and K-lines, news and regulatory filings, financial statements, analyst estimates and valuation ranks, SEC Form 4 insider trades, SEC 13F institutional holdings, IPO calendars for Hong Kong and the US, and market sentiment. Once you sign in, it also reads your own account: positions, portfolio profit and loss, assets, buying power and margin, deposits, withdrawals and linked bank cards. Symbols use the CODE.MARKET format across the US, Hong Kong, mainland China, Singapore and crypto markets, and twelve specialist sibling skills cover the deeper topics. From the longbridge/skills repository (MIT).
